params.name: sort
params.description: Override the field used for sorting the returned list. Optional.

params.name: order
params.description: Override the sort order used. Optional.

params.name: duration_sec_greater_than
params.description: Filter the results for jobs that ran for greater than or equal to this number of seconds. Optional.

params.name: duration_sec_less_than
params.description: Filter the results for the jobs that ran for less than or equal to this number of seconds. Optional.

params.name: started_before
params.description: Filter the results for the jobs that started before this timestamp. Optional.

params.name: started_after
params.description: Filter the results for the jobs that started after this timestamp. Optional.

params.name: queued_before
params.description: Filter the results for the jobs that were queued before this timestamp. Optional.

params.name: queued_after
params.description: Filter the results for the jobs that were queued after this timestamp. Optional.

params.name: ready_before
params.description: Filter the results for the jobs that are ready before this timestamp. Optional.

params.name: ready_before_current_time
params.description: When true, filters jobs ready before the current server time. Takes precedence over ready_before. Optional.

params.name: ready_after
params.description: Filter the results for the jobs that are ready after this timestamp. Optional.

params.name: ready_after_current_time
params.description: When true, filters jobs ready after the current server time. Takes precedence over ready_after. Optional.

params.name: finished_before
params.description: Filter the results for the jobs that finished before this timestamp. Optional.

params.name: finished_after
params.description: Filter the results for the jobs that finished after this timestamp. Optional.

params.name: kinds
params.description: Filter the results for the jobs of this kind. Optional.

params.name: exclude_kinds
params.description: Exclude jobs of these kinds. Takes precedence over kinds.

params.name: states
params.description: Filter the results for jobs in these states. Optional.

params.name: error_count_above
params.description: Filter the results for the jobs that had greater than or equal to this many errors. Optional.

params.name: data_plane_id
params.description: Filter the results for the jobs that were ran on this dataplane. Optional.

params.name: schedule_id
params.description: Filter the results for jobs associated with this schedule ID. Optional.

params.name: trigger_type
params.description: Filter the results for the jobs that were started by this trigger type. Optional.

params.name: triggered_by_user_id
params.description: Filter the results for the jobs that started by this user id. Only valid when trigger_type = 'user'. Optional.

params.name: triggered_by_user_email
params.description: Filter the results for the jobs that started by this user email. Only valid when trigger_type = 'user'. Optional.

params.name: model_id
params.description: Filter the results for jobs associated with this model ID. Includes jobs associated with datasets used by the model. Optional.

params.name: nonce
params.description: Filter the results for jobs that match a job nonce used to ensure exactly once execution.

params.name: page
params.description: The page to return starting from 1 up to total_pages.

params.name: page_size
params.description: The number of records per page. The max is 1000.

items.docs: Returns jobs in the project matching the filter and sorting criteria. If multiple filters are specified, results will only be returned that match all of the specified criteria. Requires project_list_jobs permission. Note: exclude_kinds takes precedence over kinds and will exclude jobs even if they are in kinds.
Submit new jobs to run. Requires project_create_job permission.
Returns the next available job for processing from the data plane's job queue. Requires data_plane_jobs_dequeue_next permission.
